class.name: emeet_camera_driver/CameraHardwareInterface
class.description: EMEET PTZ camera ros2_control hardware interface (USB HID protocol). Manages Joint4 (pan/yaw) and Joint6 (tilt/pitch) as position-controlled joints. Joint5 is treated as passive (state = 0, commands ignored). Set sim_mode=true in the URDF hardware parameters to run without physical hardware (e.g. in Gazebo).
